card.title: Stay for the Hard Part
card.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I haven't booked our anniversary trip. Can you hear why before you get your laptop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I explain?

mechanism: A reveals increasingly difficult truths about an unbooked anniversary trip while asking B to keep listening rather than fix logistics.
confusable: Unlike one disclosure, successive honesty must test continued present support under greater emotional risk.
comparison: D107-a moves from no booking to relief to doubt about us; D107-b moves from late arrival to waiting outside to fear of being unwanted.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
